name: rapidfood-agent-policy
description: Behaviour scenarios for the Rapidfood conversational agent. Run them in LangSmith (or LangGraph Studio) to check tool selection, not exact wording. The deterministic parts are covered by the pytest suite; these are LLM-behaviour evals.

scenarios.notes: Informational question: no order is created.
Must not add anything or invent ingredients.
Concrete purchase intent creates/reuses the draft.
Adds a NEW line; must not update the previous one.
A quote must not create or modify an order.
The backend quotes; the agent never states a shipping cost it did not receive.
An affirmative answer to an unrelated question is NOT a confirmation.

history: Tu pedido es: 1 x Stacker Doble. Total: 1200. Pago: efectivo. ¿Confirmás el pedido?
scenarios.notes: Only after the summary was presented does an explicit confirmation confirm.
